contract.configuration: Assignments of each named factor to a named value in the explicitly supplied admissible finite configuration list; duplicate assignments with new IDs are refused.
contract.mix: Exact rational sum of nonnegative declared weights by value, positive total; unique maximum emits that value, every tie emits the same distinguished bottom.
contract.fork: Assignments retain all factor names and values, hence are injective on the declared configurations.
contract.prior: Uniform is a selected modeling choice only when kind=uniform is explicitly present. Without a prior, unmeasured; explicit prior must name every configuration and sum exactly to one.
contract.loss: H(configuration | mix) under that prior, equal to H(configuration)-H(mix) for a deterministic projection; no causal, M/3, M/4 or algebraic-act contract is added.
contract.ceiling: budget bounds declared configuration count only; input validation, rational arithmetic and elapsed act cost are not claimed bounded by that count.

oracle.rejectedInterpretation: log2(4/3) is not the conditional loss for this prior
